notes.title: DevLog #01 - Hello and Thank You!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone!    [/p][p][/p][p]I would like to start this very first DevLog by thanking the 150 wishlists across the globe! The reception of Retro Rail GO! was way bigger and more positive than I could ever hope for! I'm really glad that you have liked this small passion project of mine and hope to make it as fun, nostalgic and good looking as you deserve it so!  [/p][p][/p][p]Now, to proper "devlogging":  The current focus has been to polish and finalize the core section of our first line: Shin-Keisei, located in Chiba Prefecture. With the help of satellite images and user's videos, I'm able to reproduce a retro version of the railway's surroundings, placing houses, buildings, roads and trees along the route. It is indeed a bit time consuming, but the visual component of the game deserves as much attention as possible, so the final experience feels authentic. Below is an image example of the ongoing process: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673896/c665fe9c9000913742921a488632488c23d567ef.png"][/img][/p][p]In parallel, work has also been done to improve the station stopping evaluation, which felt a bit too raw and harsh. In the next DevLog, I will bring the first gameplay footage, showing the replay and evaluation mechanic.  [/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p][p][/p]
